family.description: This entry represents LpqE, putative lipoprotein Lxx21020, and uncharacterised protein RP573, mainly found in bacteria. Putative lipoprotein LpqE is a membrane-associated bacterial protein predicted to be involved in cell envelope processes. As a putative lipoprotein, LpqE is likely anchored to the membrane via a lipid-modified N-terminal cysteine residue, a hallmark of bacterial lipoproteins. While its precise biological function remains uncharacterised, LpqE is commonly found in pathogenic bacteria and may contribute to host-pathogen interactions or membrane stability [[cite:PUB00161580]].
family.name: Putative lipoprotein LpqE-like
